title: Make pure-loss bosonic broadcast and trade-off capacity regions unconditional (EPnI vacuum-port corollary)
summary: Cor. thermal-attenuator at N_B=0 is exactly Guha-Shapiro-Erkmen 'Strong Conjecture 2' / De Palma's 'Conjecture 1 for the quantum-limited attenuator', for arbitrary entangled finite-energy n-mode inputs, and the EPnI itself is Lean-checked. This discharges the conditional converses of the GSE 2007 two-receiver broadcast region (done in-paper), the Wilde-Hayden-Guha 2012 pure-loss CQE and public/private/key trade-off regions (eta>1/2), De Palma 2019 Sec. VI and Cor. 12, and very likely Guha's m-receiver extension. Wiretap, quantum, private and single-user thermal capacities were already unconditional by other means (Wilde-Qi 2016-18, GGCH 2014, GHG 2015, MGH 2014).

targets.name: Wilde-Hayden-Guha PRA 86 062306 (converse Sec. III G-H assumes Strong Conjecture 2)
De Palma 2019 IEEE-TIT (Sec. VI broadcast, Cor. 12 trade-off conditional on Conj. 1 for quantum-limited attenuator)
De Palma-Trevisan-Giovannetti-Ambrosio survey (Conj. V.1, V.15 listed open)

beneficiaries: Quantum Shannon theorists; authors of optical/satellite ultimate-capacity analyses; textbook and survey maintainers
first_step: Line-by-line check of WHG 2012 Sec. III G-H converse against Cor. thermal-attenuator (N_B=0, transmissivity eta and (1-eta)/eta); then a short public note plus emails to Wilde/Guha/De Palma.
measurement: Number of capacity regions moved from 'conditional' to 'theorem' in literature (target 4); author acknowledgements/errata; survey/textbook updates.
risks: WHG may use SC2 in a form needing one extra lemma; corollary not Lean-formalized; all OpenAI work unrefereed; does NOT cover amplifiers, mode-dependent loss, thermal-channel trade-offs.

title: Thermal-noise (and m-receiver) bosonic broadcast converse from the EPnI
summary: The loss-plus-thermal-noise broadcast region (Guha 2008 thesis; Anderson-Guha-Bash ISIT 2021, incl. covert broadcast) is conditional on a thermal strong-MOE conjecture. 273's thermal-attenuator corollary (N_B>0) supplies the entropy bound; what is missing is convexity of phi_{lam,N'}(u)=g(lam g^{-1}(u)+(1-lam)N') for N'>0 (the paper proves only N'=0) plus a degradation/noise-ordering argument. Our numerics found phi convex on the whole tested grid (min 2nd divided difference +5.3e-4).

targets.name: Anderson-Guha-Bash ISIT 2021 'Fundamental limits of bosonic broadcast channels'

beneficiaries: Bosonic network information theory; covert/LPI optical communication theory
first_step: Attempt analytic phi'' >= 0 for N'>0 mirroring the paper's L119-128 computation; then write the converse with GHG 2015 for the strong receiver.
measurement: Written proof (ideally Lean) of thermal broadcast converse; acceptance by Guha/Bash.
risks: Convexity may fail at edge parameters or need restrictions; noise-ordering requirements could restrict the region's validity.

title: Exact GADC classical-capacity function as reference implementation and benchmark ground truth
summary: Thm main gives C = (1/ln2) max_p {h((1-g)p+g nu) - g_det(g nu(1-nu)+g(1-g)(p-nu)^2)}, Lean-checked and validated by us against brute-force Holevo optimisation (1e-15) and a 2-use entangled-ensemble search (no superadditivity to 1e-8). It replaces bound tables: KSW 2020 bounds overshoot by 0.10-0.37 bits (often >100%); Fang 2026's converse is within <=0.13 bits (N=0), 0.04-0.09 bits for N<=0.1, <0.003 bits for N>=0.4. Useful as exact ground truth for converse-bound methods; no engineering consequence.

title: N(6)=3: obtain the missing verification artifacts and re-run independently (ideally in interval arithmetic)
summary: Thm main is explicitly conditional on a C++ pipeline (seed/covout/ub/patchx/atlas/stageB/stageC.cpp, extraction.json, proof_run.py, build-manifest, REPRODUCE.md, execution archive) that is absent from every public ref of openai/math (main fd4aeeb, PR ref 3014888, initial commit adc7f12), from the PDF (no attachments), lean/ and reasoning_traces/. The ~80 code routines analysed in the rounding appendix cannot be checked. Only N(6)<=5 (exact rational certificate + Weiner completion) is proved openly and Lean-checked. Confidence in the N(6)=3 proof: 2/5; as a fact it is very likely true (all numerics agree).

title: Update open-problem lists and references: OQP #24 (key from all entangled states), OQP #38 (PPT-squared), MUB d=6 status
summary: 272 answers OQP #24 negatively (explicit 10x10 PPT-entangled state with K_D=0 in an admitted two-way model, uniform 1/10 trace-distance gap) and disproves PPT-squared in both the two-map and single-channel (M_21) forms, both Lean comparator-checked; via the Choi isomorphism this also refutes OQP #38's state-swapping form. For 266 the accurate status line is 'N(6)<=5 proved (exact + Lean); N(6)=3 claimed, computer-assisted, artifacts unpublished'.

title: Key repeaters over PPT links: swap-then-distill still yields zero key (the operational consequence PPT-squared was wanted for)
summary: PPT states are Choi matrices of PPT maps; swapping two of them with any BC effect M gives sigma_AD proportional to [(F^dag (x) G^dag)(M)]^T (verified numerically to 1.8e-12 relative), which lies in the paper's represented class C, so Thm zero-key gives K_D(sigma_AD)=0 even though Thm main-pair shows sigma_AD can be entangled. Likewise any end-to-end state through PPT link - arbitrary CP station operation - PPT link is in C. This rescues the 'PPT states are useless in (swap-then-distill) key repeaters' conclusion without PPT-squared, strengthening Bauml-Christandl-Horodecki-Winter's bound for this protocol class; fully adaptive tripartite LOCC repeaters remain open.

targets.name: Bauml-Christandl-Horodecki-Winter, Limitations on quantum key repeaters (Nat. Commun. 2015)

first_step: Write a 3-page note: Choi-swap identity + flag trick placing station-conditioned states in C; check conditioning on the station's public outcome against Prop. operational-extensions; test adaptive station protocols.
measurement: Note posted/refereed; acknowledgement by repeater-limitations authors.
risks: Our derivation is unrefereed; zero-key theorem lacks a comparator formalization; protocol-model mismatches (aborts, adaptive multi-round station) could limit scope.

title: Explicit 10x10 PPT-entangled zero-key state as a hard benchmark for separability software
summary: We rebuilt rho=Z/trZ from the paper's integer pencil: PPT, rank 80/100, full local ranks; not detected by CCNR (||R(rho)||_1=0.539<1) or the reduction criterion (min eig +4.9e-4); entanglement is certified only by the product-free-range argument. toqito's full is_separable ran out of 7 GB memory on it. A natural stress test for separability toolkits.
first_step: Publish the 100x100 matrix (scratch_qinfo/zero_key_state.py) and open a toqito issue proposing it as a regression test that must never return 'separable'.
measurement: Inclusion in test suites; which criterion (if any) detects it and at what cost.
risks: Limited uptake; DPS hierarchy at 10x10 is expensive, so tests may be skipped.

title: DO NOT: use threshold parallel repetition for practical (parallel) DIQKD rates
summary: Explicit cubic rate delta^3/(16384(1+kappa_mu)(1+ln d)) needs ~8.7e10 rounds (CHSH, delta=0.1) to 8e11 (magic square) just for 1e-10 soundness concentration, versus 1.5e6 rounds in the EAT-based Nadlinger et al. 2022 experiment; the universal delta^5 rate has a non-explicit constant from an unrefereed lemma. Threshold concentration above v is not a min-entropy bound and does not apply directly to honest CHSH devices.

Vidick parallel DIQKD from parallel repetition

title: DO NOT: claim the EPnI settles amplifier, mode-dependent-loss, thermal wiretap or thermal-channel trade-off capacities
summary: The paper disclaims amplifiers, mode-dependent attenuations, additive-noise channels, noisy broadcast, wiretap and quantum capacity. Non-degradable thermal channels need regularized converses; mode-dependent loss needs a non-identical-mode EPnI (open). Pure-loss wiretap/private/quantum and single-user thermal capacities were already unconditional (Wilde-Qi 2016-18; GGCH 2014; GHG 2015; MGH 2014), so citing 273 as 'resolving' them is wrong. Quantitatively, EPnI improves qEPI-based capacity upper bounds for non-Gaussian environments by only 0.02-0.055 bits in our test.

title: DO NOT: treat the GADC capacity as relevant to superconducting-qubit engineering or code design
summary: At transmon-like parameters (nu=0.008-0.05, gamma=1e-3..1e-2) C=0.975-0.997 bits and prior bounds were already within 0.5-4.5e-3 bits; nobody operates qubits as classical channels at capacity, and the result says nothing about quantum capacity or error correction.

title: DO NOT: redesign d=6 tomography/QKD or cite N(6)=3 as established
summary: Practice (qubit-qutrit tomography, OAM HD-QKD, photonic 'qusix' tests) already assumes no complete MUB set in d=6 and uses 2-3 bases, SIC-POVMs or product measurements; nothing changes operationally. The upper bound 3 is not independently checkable until the artifacts are released.

title: DO NOT: change deployed QKD security proofs or key-rate software because of the zero-key state
summary: Fielded QKD computes protocol-specific key rates numerically and never treated entanglement as sufficient; PPT-squared was already known for Gaussian channels, so optical networks have no non-EB PPT links. The construction is a 10x10 abstract state with no physical source.
